name: Abhishek Finlease Limited
about: Abhishek Finlease Limited operates as a non-deposit taking core investment company in India. The company offers investment consultancy for long-term and short-term finance investments. It also engages in the sale of shares and securities; and short-term finance activities. The company was formerly known as V.M. Shah Finlease Private Limited and changed its name to Abhishek Finlease Limited in March 1995. Abhishek Finlease Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
